descriptions.d24l_textbox_cursor_802a2524: Creates a text box cursor when +392 is empty: reads the 'FE.TextBoxTextSize' property into a vector's y (0x800fc270), halves it for x and y, loads 'FE.Textbox.Cursor' with type byte(+35)+30, stores the cast mesh retained at +392, calls its virtual +88 with 0, scales it (+84) and attaches it to the panel +308 (+92).
